test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the jumbled words and choose the alternative that correctly matches the given sentence.

The youth ___________ now-a-days.

life / of / today / a / leading / are / miserable

options.text: today are leading of a miserable life
of today are leading a miserable life
are today leading of a miserable life
today are leading a miserable life of

solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **of today are leading a miserable life**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "of today," which correctly sets the context of the youth in question.** **
 
• Following "of today," the phrase "are leading" comes next, indicating the action being taken by the youth.
 
• Next, "a miserable life" completes the sentence by describing the condition of the youth.

Therefore, the correct answer is **of today are leading a miserable life.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "today are leading of a miserable life" is grammatically incorrect as it misplaces the phrase "of today."
 
• **Option 3:** "are today leading of a miserable life" is also grammatically incorrect as it misplaces the phrase "of today."
 
• **Option 4:** "today are leading a miserable life of" is incorrect because it leaves the sentence incomplete and awkwardly places "of" at the end.
